text_block_list.text: I forgot something during daytime training. Remembering it, I went back to fetch it, but—
(Drip... drip...)
No need to linger. Just as I looked for my things and prepared to hurry back to the Trainer's office—
......Did you... forg... something...?
Even though nobody should be here, I thought I heard someone's voice...
I was scared to turn around. ...No, it's surely just my imagination—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I am... sorry... I was only... submerged... I didn't mean... to scare you...
Being apologized to made me feel even more awkward. It was entirely my fault for assuming no one was here and scaring myself.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: At this hour... very few people... come here...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I... like it... underwater... It is cold... and quiet...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The only one here... is myself... Secretive... and free...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Being cut off from the outside world... brings peace... Or so... it feels...
Watching her speak while gazing off into the distance, I felt a strange sense of fascination.
It seemed that spending time underwater was truly precious to Manhattan Cafe. —Just then...
Because it won't be an experiment without two people~! Cafe was definitely seen around here earlier—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh? How strange, she ought to be here— Hey, you there!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes, you! Have you seen Cafe? I came because I have a favor to ask of her—
Not understanding her question, I looked behind me, only to find Manhattan Cafe had vanished without a trace.
choice_data_list: Wait, she was definitely right there a second ago?!

text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, right before Agnes Tachyon and the other approached, I heard a faint splash as Manhattan Cafe submerged.
She cherishes her quiet time. She's probably not in the mood to see anyone right now. Deciding not to reveal her hiding spot—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What a shame~~! And here I was planning to have Cafe and Pocket-kun assist in a special experiment testing an umamusume's limits today!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: After all, my personal masterpiece device is finally complete! A custom-made running wheel with ten stages of resistance!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: With that, we could measure running power, endurance, visual perception effects, stress levels, and even the psychological impact of comparative side-by-side pacing—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In short! A multitude of experiments so vast that running all night long wouldn't even be enough!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: HAAAH?! Run all night long?! You were seriously plannin' to make us do that crap?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Screw that noise, count me out!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Aahh! If you leave too, what happens to my experiment?! Hey, Pocket-kun, wait! HEEEYYY, waaaaait!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Whenever... I get involved with Tachyon-san and the others... it tends to become troublesome...
It seemed covering for her had been the right choice. Manhattan Cafe breathed a quiet sigh of relief.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ah, oi! There's some kinda black shadow underwater!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: My my, playing hide-and-seek? How delightfully adorable of you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Did you want to play with us that badly?! Fear not, we shall play together to your heart's content right after this! Come now, come on, come on, out you get!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: What's up with you? Stay in the water too long and get all pruny?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hurry up and get changed before ya catch a cold. Then let's go blow off some steam together!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Haah... I suppose I have no choice...
Manhattan Cafe resignedly followed the two. Even so, her expression didn't look nearly as reluctant as her words suggested.
She prefers solitude, but she is far from isolated. Seeing that brought a sense of relief.
